failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Wrong slot type: 'this man' / 'this author' clues were answered with the effect, case or thing ('Hawking radiation', 'segregated school') instead of the person's name.

rejected_edits.content:
## Answer procedure (mandatory; this is the check line, write it once before every answer)
`Type: <noun the clue asks for> | Evidence: <quoted passage line or own fact> | Check: <candidate fits the clue's blank, is not a clue word, and matches one distinctive clue detail (team, number, size, year)>`
- Substitution test: put the candidate into the clue's 'this X' slot. If it becomes a different kind of thing (an event instead of a city, a base instead of an acid) or repeats a noun the clue already states, reject it and pick again.
- Title + name ('President X') asks for what the person leads. A quote asks for the speaker, usually by famous surname. Match the singular or plural of the clue's noun.
- Archive hit 'clue | X. right:' -> answer exactly X, nothing added. A first name alone, or one member of a list of names, is never the answer.

- PERSON SLOT: 'this man / this author / he / she / this <occupation>' plus a deed, discovery, lawsuit or work asks for the PERSON who did it, as 'First Last'. Passages are often full of the effect, theory, case or place named after that person ('X radiation', 'X v. Board'). Those are the wrong type. Name the plaintiff, discoverer or author the passages tie to the clue's action.
rejected_edits.target: - Ask: what category is the answer (country, person, vitamin, object, band), and what member of that category fits all the clue details?
